`noise_ik_vector.json` is herdr's `src/guest/link/testdata/noise_ik_vector.json`, copied unchanged from jerryfane/herdr commit f0b7ae61 (sha256 a517498d…f9ef49), where it was generated with snow by `cargo test write_noise_ik_vector -- --ignored`. The Go guest client (`internal/guest/noise_vector_test.go`) and the web guest (`test/webguestNoise.test.ts`) both reproduce it, so herdr, Go and TypeScript are pinned to one transcript.
